title: ЗАКОН ЗА ДЪРЖАВНИТЕ ТАКСИ
evidence: The four candidates (materials 87379, 89943, 99467, 244368) repeal MVR instructions, an MVR ordinance and the port fees tariff of ДП „Пристанищна инфраструктура“, sharing only the words "държавните" or "такси", so none names this law; lex.bg records it vigente with 42 amendment rows, the last ДВ 20/2021 (2021-03-09).
